items.prompt:
How an author arranges the parts of a text is its:
A) structure
B) font
C) length

A paragraph that gives a vivid example mainly:
A) develops and supports a claim
B) ends the essay
C) restates the title
items.answer: A) develops and supports a claim

solution.answer: A) develops and supports a claim

items.prompt:
Adding nuance or precision to an idea:
A) refines it
B) deletes it
C) hides it

A later section distinguishes two kinds of the problem the essay first defined. This section:
A) refines the idea by adding precision
B) changes the subject
C) contradicts the essay
items.answer: A) refines the idea by adding precision

solution.answer: A) refines the idea by adding precision

items.prompt:
A paragraph placing a concrete example right after a general claim:
A) develops the claim with support
B) weakens the claim
C) is off-topic
items.answer: A) develops the claim with support

solution.answer: A) develops the claim with support

items.prompt:
Why analyze how SECTIONS develop and refine ideas?
A) to see how the parts work together to build and sharpen the point
B) to count words
C) to ignore the argument
items.answer: A) to see how the parts work together to build and sharpen the point

steps: Parts build the whole. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to see how the parts work together to build and sharpen the point

items.prompt:
